# TPC-DS-OBT Q91

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT call_center_cc_call_center_id AS Call_Center, call_center_cc_name AS Call_Center_Name, call_center_cc_manager AS Manager, SUM(return_net_loss) AS Returns_Loss FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (call_center_sk = call_center_cc_call_center_sk AND returned_date_sk = return_date_d_date_sk AND returning_customer_c_customer_sk = bill_customer_c_customer_sk AND bill_cdemo_cd_demo_sk = bill_customer_c_current_cdemo_sk AND bill_hdemo_hd_demo_sk = bill_customer_c_current_hdemo_sk AND bill_addr_ca_address_sk = bill_customer_c_current_addr_sk AND return_date_d_year = 1998 AND return_date_d_moy = 11 AND ((bill_cdemo_cd_marital_status = 'M' AND bill_cdemo_cd_education_status = 'Unknown') OR (bill_cdemo_cd_marital_status = 'W' AND bill_cdemo_cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree')) AND bill_hdemo_hd_buy_potential LIKE '1001-5000%' AND bill_addr_ca_gmt_offset = -6) AND channel = 'catalog' GROUP BY call_center_cc_call_center_id, call_center_cc_name, call_center_cc_manager, bill_cdemo_cd_marital_status, bill_cdemo_cd_education_status ORDER BY SUM(return_net_loss) DESC
```
